# media type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:mediaType`](gmeow-mediaType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mediaType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The IANA media (MIME) type of an artifact — 'text/plain', 'application/pdf', 'image/avif'. Universal: an email body part, a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md), a [`Distribution`](../classes/gmeow-Distribution.md) all carry one. Projects to [schema:encodingFormat.](https://schema.org/encodingFormat.) (Generalised from the email slice.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the IANA media (MIME) type of any content carrier — a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md), an email body part, a distribution file; functional, one media type per artifact.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the natural language of the content (use [`gmeow:contentLanguage`](gmeow-contentLanguage.md)) and avoid asserting two media types on one artifact — model distinct encodings as distinct carrier objects.

### How to use

- Carry the MIME string on [`gmeow:mediaType`](gmeow-mediaType.md) of the concrete carrier; it projects to [schema:encodingFormat.](https://schema.org/encodingFormat.) Pair with [`gmeow:contentLanguage`](gmeow-contentLanguage.md) and the relevant pixel/extent metadata on a [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md).

### Examples

- ex:attachment [`gmeow:mediaType`](gmeow-mediaType.md) "application/pdf".
